description: Editorial and taxonomy registration for one bounded practical task-initiation starter. The protocol is classified as practical because its inherited claims were removed; this registry does not promote the five-minute interval as an evidence-based optimum or claim that it resolves procrastination.

stop-procrastination-fast-5-minute-reset.note: The effective public content is a low-risk task-initiation checkpoint: define one visible first action, begin for a bounded interval, then continue, clarify, shrink the step or resolve a blocker. Fabricated trials, percentages, mechanisms, habit-formation claims and universal effectiveness language are removed.

stop-procrastination-fast-5-minute-reset.reason: The effective protocol addresses the concrete problem of beginning an avoided task by defining a visible first action and reviewing blockers after a bounded attempt. Task Initiation is the primary Topic; Planning & Prioritization captures the explicit continue, clarify, defer or stop decision. Grandmaster remains legacy navigation only.
